entities.summary: Church of the Transfer of the Relics of St. Nicholas the Wonderworker in Vilnius or St. Nicholas Church is one of the oldest Eastern Orthodox churches in Vilnius, Lithuania, and belongs to the Russian Orthodox Diocese of Lithuania.
